project.name: Samitt.com
project.summary: Jeff Samitt's personal site at samitt.co — a single-page Next.js portfolio for recruiters, founders and execs, with a Resend-backed contact form.

goals: Win consulting and role leads through the contact form
Showcase what I'm building — keep Currently Building, GitHub and Selected Work current and credible

manual: Open the Vercel preview (or npm run dev) and eyeball the changed sections at desktop and phone width
If the contact form or /api/contact changed: submit a real test message on the preview and confirm it arrives in Gmail with reply-to set

risk_focus: Contact form delivery: /api/contact must keep sending via Resend from jeff@samitt.co to jsamitt@gmail.com with reply-to set; a silent failure means lost leads with no alert.
RESEND_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID live in Vercel env vars; changes must never hardcode, log or expose the Resend key client-side.

Contact form abuse: the endpoint has no rate limit, honeypot or input length caps; changes must not widen this, and anything touching it should consider spam burning Resend quota or getting samitt.co flagged.
Every push to main deploys straight to production on Vercel with no staging gate; a change that builds but renders broken, or breaks metadata/OG image/sitemap/robots, goes live immediately.

rules: Marigold (accent) is only ever a fill behind ink text, never a text colour on light backgrounds — it measures 1.7:1 on page and is unreadable
Outline form fields with the field token, never rule — rule is 1.35:1 against page and invisible as a control boundary

Use the role tokens (page, surface, band, ink, ink-muted, rule, field, accent, on-dark…) for colour; no raw hex or Tailwind palette colours (white/10, gray-400) in components. Legacy navy/teal/mint tokens are for unmigrated code only
Headings and figures use font-display (Bricolage Grotesque); body text uses font-body (Figtree)
Layout must work at phone width with no horizontal scroll

steps.name: Vercel auto-deploys main — wait for the deployment to go green in the Vercel dashboard
